datasets.title: Floods over Cox's Bazar area, Bangladesh - UNOSAT Live Web Map
datasets.description: UNOSAT code: FL20210729BGD This is a web map showing analysis and results related to floods in Cox's Bazar area, Chittagong division, Bangladesh. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/floods-over-cox-s-bazar-area-bangladesh-unosat-live-web-map]
datasets.details: This is a preliminary assessment and has not yet been validated in the field. It is important to consider the characteristics of the source imagery used in the analyses when interpreting results. For damage assessments it should be noted that only significant damage to the structural integrity of the buildings analyzed can be seen in imagery, while minor damage such as cracks or holes may not be visible at all. For flood extractions using radar data it is important to note that urban areas and highly vegetated areas may mask the flood signature and result in underestimation of flood waters. Users with specific questions or concerns should contact unosat@unitar.org to seek clarification.

lineage.description: UNOSAT analysts reviewed and compared satellite imagery from before and after the July 2021 flooding event in Cox's Bazar, Bangladesh, to identify and delineate water bodies and flood extent. The resulting flood extent polygons were classified by water status and confidence level, with field validation and sensor metadata recorded for quality assurance.

sources.name: United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT)
sources.description: Satellite imagery analysis and interpretation to delineate flood extent and water classification in Cox's Bazar area during the July 2021 flood event
